ruling.recommended_action: Refund the $6.61 cancellation fee to the rider as a Ryde voucher; note on the driver's record that the "I'm Here"/waiting-window conditions of NS-1 were not met.
ruling.reasoning:
Dispute type is no_show, rider-filed, driver cancelled (cancelled_by = driver) and the driver claims rider no-show, so NS-0 routes the case to NS-1/NS-2.

NS-1 requires all three: (i) the driver pressed "I'm Here" / arrival was platform-confirmed, (ii) at the moment of the tap the GPS shows the driver at the pickup (≤ 200 m), and (iii) after the tap the driver waited continuously > 3 minutes at the pickup up to the cancellation.

(i) driver_pressed_here_at = 13:02:35; arrival_confirmed_by is null, so this is a driver tap.

(ii) Distances from the pickup (Tampines Mall, 1.3525 N 103.9447 E), haversine on the thinned GPS grid (nearest sample 13:02:30, ~30 s before the stated tap):
• 13:02:00 (1.353075, 103.944617) → 65 m north of the pickup — within radius;
• 13:02:30 (1.352366, 103.944349) → 42.5 m west of the pickup — within radius;
• 13:05:30 (1.352382, 103.944379) → 39 m west of the pickup — within radius.
So the driver was at the pickup both just before and just after the 13:02:35 tap. Because of the 30 s sampling, whether he was ≤200 m exactly at the second of the tap cannot be read off the record, but he did not move between 13:02:30 and 13:05:30 (speed 0.9–2.1 km/h) and was ~42 m from the pickup at cancel time, so (ii) is at worst neutral.

(iii) Fails. The driver pressed "I'm Here" at 13:02:35 and cancelled at 13:05:30 — an elapsed span of 2 min 55 s, i.e. 5 seconds short of the required > 3:00. The GPS confirms the car was stationary at the pickup from 13:02:30 to 13:05:30 (four samples at the same coordinates, speed < 2.2 km/h, ~39–43 m from the pickup), matching the driver's own 13:05:20 message "More than 3 min already, I have to cancel" — sent 2:45 after the tap and 10 s before the cancellation. Nothing in the record supports treating his pre-tap loitering as part of the wait: the policy counts only the continuous wait after the "I'm Here" tap. (No case-record no-show threshold or free_wait_time value was supplied, so the default 3-minute rule applies.)

Since NS-1 (iii) is not satisfied, NS-2 applies: the $6.61 cancellation fee is not chargeable and is refunded in full to the rider. The rider's own account (coming out a minute after the cancellation) is consistent with the timing and is not needed to decide the case.

The GPS is thinned to 30 s, but there is no gap (> 2 min, or > 2× the trace's normal sampling interval — here three consecutive ~60 s intervals are all equally spaced) and the trace covers the cancellation instant, so no G12 referral is warranted. The driver did not press "I'm Here" while outside the 200 m radius, so no fraud flag under NS-2; the profiles (driver no_show_disputes_upheld_90d = 1) are not a basis for flagging here.

Safety screen: the two chat messages and the driver's statement contain no threat, intimidation, harassment, sexual remark or dangerous-driving allegation. Nothing to refer under SAFE-1/SAFE-2.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver claims he waited more than 3 minutes at the pickup after pressing 'I'm Here', but the tap was at 13:02:35 and the cancellation at 13:05:30 — only 2 min 55 s — so the NS-1 (iii) continuous-wait condition is not met; his own message at 13:05:20 shows he cancelled before the 3-minute mark was reached.
